gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-cossette-texte: Expressive and wiry, Funnel Display draws every stroke alike. Cossette Texte sits beneath it in sans-serif form, with a prominent x-height and wide-eyed e shapes that make the lines feel open.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-duru-sans: Wire-thin swagger, then a wide-mouthed body. Funnel Display bends every letter like a pipe cleaner, while Duru Sans lets its small letters dominate the line, ascenders barely showing.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-fresca: Funnel Display looks bent from a single strand of spaghetti. It grabs attention with that unvarying line, while Fresca keeps its counters connected to the outside and its bowls big, with short ascenders.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-funnel-sans: Commanding, wiry letters lead here in Funnel Display. Funnel Sans keeps its stroke widths steady from stem to curve and its e opened wide, though shrinking the heading would drain its presence.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-gafata: Expressive and flat-lined like a fineliner on paper, Funnel Display leads over Gafata's tall band of lowercase with its short stalks above. Their strongest quality is that tension.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-geist: Geist hums along as a quiet, level beat in sans-serif, its words forming solid blocks. Funnel Display does the shouting, with spaghetti-like strokes and c tips that never drift toward touching.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-georama: Approachable and open, Georama has a c like a bracelet pulled apart and capitals that barely rise. Beside Funnel Display, whose stroke weight never varies, it is the softer partner.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-gidole: Gidole draws every stroke like a neon tube, its terminals parted like open scissor blades. Funnel Display brings the drama above it, so only the plain sans body needs enlarging.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-golos-text: Expressive wire-like capitals set the tone, with Funnel Display's strokes never varying. Golos Text answers with an x-height that fills the line and a widely parted s, in sans form.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hedvig-letters-: Funnel Display looks bent from a single wire, commanding and low in contrast. Hedvig Letters Sans follows in plain sans, its clear gap where the c ends and small letters nearly capital height.
